editorial.blurb: A nimble neighborhood spot slinging Vietnamese and Chinese comfort food with generous portions and friendly service at prices that won't break the bank.
editorial.insiderTip: Order ahead online for pickup—staff nails accuracy and timing, and you'll dodge the college-crowd rush near Argyle.
